summary: Comprehensive testing of Evidence Integrity API and Police Accountability Portal. All 14 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend testing verified all tabs (Departments, Officers, Rankings) and Report Violation dialog functionality with successful form submission.
passed_tests: GET /api/accountability/public/departments - Returns list of departments with scores
GET /api/accountability/public/officers - Returns list of officers with violations
POST /api/evidence-integrity/register - Registers new evidence with SHA-256 hash
GET /api/evidence-integrity/{id}/custody-chain - Returns chain of custody events
Multiple violation types (excessive_force, unlawful_search, false_arrest, miranda_violation, recording_interference) - All work correctly
Frontend: Accountability Portal page loads with stats (14 Departments, 109 Officers, 150 Violations)
Frontend: Departments tab displays department cards with accountability scores
Frontend: Officers tab displays officers with badge numbers and violation counts
Frontend: Rankings tab shows Best Performing and Needs Improvement departments
Frontend: Report Violation dialog opens with all form fields
Frontend: Report Violation form submission works - success toast displayed
critical_code_review_comments: Evidence Integrity system properly implements SHA-256 hashing with HMAC signatures
Chain of custody uses linked hash chain (each event hash includes previous event hash)
Court package generation includes all required forensic metadata and legal notice
Accountability Portal correctly displays seeded data (12 departments, 98 officers, 139 violations)
Report Violation form has proper data-testid attributes for all interactive elements
seed_data_creation: Test violations created during testing with badge numbers: TEST123, AUTOTEST123, and various TEST* prefixed badges
context_for_next_testing_agent: Evidence Integrity and Accountability Portal APIs are fully functional. All CRUD operations work. Frontend Accountability Portal page at /accountability route works correctly with all three tabs (Departments, Officers, Rankings) and Report Violation dialog. Blockchain anchoring is MOCKED (local mode - simulated, not connected to real Ethereum).

mocked_apis_list: Ethereum blockchain anchoring - simulated with local storage (BlockchainNetwork.LOCAL)

features: Chain of custody with linked hashes
Court package generation with legal notice

frontend_features: Stats cards (Departments, Officers Tracked, Violations, Settlements)
Report Violation dialog with form validation
